SELECT i.* FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.id
AND i.erp_tenant_id = #{qo.erpTenantId} AND w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' AND w.deleted = 0
AND i.warehouse_id = #{qo.warehouseId}
AND i.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.skuCode}, '%')
AND i.warehouse_id IN (SELECT id FROM wms_warehouse WHERE region_id = #{qo.regionId})
AND i.damaged_quantity > 0
AND (i.available_quantity + i.reserved_quantity + i.in_transit_quantity + i.damaged_quantity) > 0
AND i.available_quantity = 0 AND i.reserved_quantity = 0 AND i.in_transit_quantity = 0 AND i.damaged_quantity = 0
AND i.available_quantity < 0
ORDER BY i.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_code) AS totalSkuCount, COALESCE(SUM(i.available_quantity), 0) AS availableQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.reserved_quantity), 0) AS reservedQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.in_transit_quantity), 0) AS inTransitQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.damaged_quantity), 0) AS damagedQuantity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_warehouse WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND warehouse_type = 'OWN') AS warehouseCount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN s.package_length IS NOT NULL AND s.package_width IS NOT NULL AND s.package_height IS NOT NULL AND s.package_length > 0 AND s.package_width > 0 AND s.package_height > 0 THEN s.package_length * s.package_width * s.package_height * POWER( CASE COALESCE(UPPER(s.package_unit), 'M') WHEN 'CM' THEN 0.01 WHEN 'MM' THEN 0.001 ELSE 1 END, 3) * (i.available_quantity + i.reserved_quantity) ELSE 0 END ), 0), 2) AS totalVolume, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i2.sku_code) FROM wms_inventory i2 INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w2 ON w2.id = i2.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sku s2 ON i2.sku_code = s2.sku_code WHERE i2.erp_tenant_id = #{erpTenantId} AND w2.warehouse_type = 'OWN' AND w2.deleted = 0 AND (s2.package_length IS NULL OR s2.package_width IS NULL OR s2.package_height IS NULL OR s2.package_length <= 0 OR s2.package_width <= 0 OR s2.package_height <= 0) ) AS volumeMissingSkuCount FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON i.sku_code = s.sku_code WHERE i.erp_tenant_id = #{erpTenantId} AND w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' AND w.deleted = 0

SELECT w.id AS warehouseId, COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_code) AS skuCount, COALESCE(SUM(i.available_quantity), 0) AS availableQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.reserved_quantity), 0) AS reservedQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.in_transit_quantity), 0) AS inTransitQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.damaged_quantity), 0) AS damagedQuantity, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN s.package_length IS NOT NULL AND s.package_width IS NOT NULL AND s.package_height IS NOT NULL AND s.package_length > 0 AND s.package_width > 0 AND s.package_height > 0 THEN s.package_length * s.package_width * s.package_height * POWER( CASE COALESCE(UPPER(s.package_unit), 'M') WHEN 'CM' THEN 0.01 WHEN 'MM' THEN 0.001 ELSE 1 END, 3) * (i.available_quantity + i.reserved_quantity) ELSE 0 END ), 0), 2) AS totalVolume FROM wms_warehouse w LEFT JOIN wms_inventory i ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND i.erp_tenant_id = #{erpTenantId} LEFT JOIN sku s ON i.sku_code = s.sku_code WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 AND w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' GROUP BY w.id ORDER BY availableQuantity DESC

SELECT x.sku_code AS skuCode, MAX(x.warehouse_count) AS warehouseCount, SUM(x.available_quantity) AS availableQuantity, SUM(x.reserved_quantity) AS reservedQuantity, SUM(x.in_transit_quantity) AS inTransitQuantity, SUM(x.damaged_quantity) AS damagedQuantity, SUM(x.fbo_quantity) AS fboWarehouseQuantity, SUM(x.own_quantity) AS ownWarehouseQuantity FROM ( SELECT i.sku_code, COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count, SUM(i.available_quantity) AS available_quantity, SUM(i.reserved_quantity) AS reserved_quantity, SUM(i.in_transit_quantity) AS in_transit_quantity, SUM(i.damaged_quantity) AS damaged_quantity, 0 AS fbo_quantity, SUM(i.available_quantity + i.reserved_quantity) AS own_quantity FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE i.erp_tenant_id = #{erpTenantId} AND w.warehouse_type = 'OWN' AND w.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.sku_code UNION ALL SELECT f.sku_code, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, SUM(f.quantity), 0 FROM wms_fbo_inventory_snapshot f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{erpTenantId} GROUP BY f.sku_code ) x
AND x.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY x.sku_code
HAVING (SUM(x.available_quantity) + SUM(x.reserved_quantity) + SUM(x.in_transit_quantity) + SUM(x.fbo_quantity)) > 0
HAVING (SUM(x.available_quantity) + SUM(x.reserved_quantity) + SUM(x.in_transit_quantity) + SUM(x.fbo_quantity)) = 0
HAVING SUM(x.available_quantity) < 0
ORDER BY availableQuantity DESC

SELECT i.sku_code AS skuCode, i.available_quantity AS availableQuantity FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN sku s ON i.sku_code = s.sku_code
i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND i.available_quantity > 0
AND (i.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.chinese_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY i.sku_code ASC
